_readme: EveryTip offers. Edit headline, terms, buttonText or link, set active to false to hide an offer, and positions are re-ranked every Monday on the previous week's /go/ clicks (scripts/rerank-offers.mjs), so a manual position only lasts until then. pinned N holds an offer at position N whatever its clicks (Betfred is pinned at 1). A new partner gets newUntil (YYYY-MM-DD, a week after it goes live) and is held at #3 until that date. id is the WordPress offer ID that in-article offer blocks point to; keep it unchanged. A new partner who has not paid yet carries "preview": "<slug>": it is left out of every normal build and only shows in that partner's preview (npm run partner:preview <slug>); npm run partner:live <slug> removes it once the partner has paid.
